earlier_scan.note: Borna (DRC, bxx) has essentially no documentation: Glottolog's only record is the 2014 ISO 639-3 registration document.

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority (Editor, Ethnologue / SIL International). 2014. Change Request Number 2014-032: adopted, retire [bxx] (2015-01-12). 5 pp.
sources.note: Nothing; it is a code-retirement form. Reason ticked: 'There is no evidence that the language exists.' Rationale (p. 2): the entry can only derive from Welmers (1971:786), a checklist compiled from hand-written 1959 US Office of Education sheets, and 'there is considerable likelihood that Borna is a misreading of Boma or eBoma (the entry for which is Teke-Eboo [ebo])'. Only source cited: Welmers 1971 name checklist. No linguistic data.
Nothing; entry 'retired and featured here only for bookkeeping purposes', reason 'non-existent'; zero references besides the ISO change request.
